question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Habitant
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(1) i.e.** 'Denizen'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Habitant'** means a person who inhabits a particular place.

 
 
• **Example:** Last year there were 130 murders for every 100,000 **habitants** in the city.
 
 
 
• The word** 'Denizen'** means a person, animal, or plant that lives or is found in a particular place.
 
 
• **Example: ** Deer and squirrels are among the **denizens** of the forest.
 
 
 
• As both the words** Habitant and Denizen** are similar in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options are**:

 
 
• **Endemic- **(of a disease) regularly occurring within an area or community.**(स्थानिक)**
 
• **Transient- **lasting only for a short time; impermanent. **(क्षणिक)**
 
• **Exile- **the state of being barred from one's native country, typically for political or punitive reasons.** (बनवास)**
